scheme_name: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Differently Abled Parents (Parinayam-I)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala.
The parents must be differently‑abled and eligible to apply under the scheme.
Assistance can be sought for up to two daughters, with the second daughter’s assistance eligible only after three years from the first grant.
If a daughter remarries after a divorce, the family income is calculated including any compensation received from the ex‑husband.
If the differently‑abled parent dies before the daughters’ marriage, the assistance may be given to the elder or any responsible family member.
If the parent dies after the daughter’s marriage but before receiving assistance, the senior or married family member may receive the assistance.
The application must be submitted at least one month before the scheduled marriage date (for Muslim brides, the date after the Nikah ceremony is considered).
benefits_summary: One‑time assistance of ₹30,000 per daughter for the marriage of up to two daughters of differently‑abled parents.
